Subject: Pen-test scope proposal + constraints

Team — forwarding proposed pen-test scope and a few constraints from infra. I attached pen-test-scope.txt with the full checklist; summary below:

- Scope: external network + API endpoints used by FastPay (production-narrowed endpoints), no internal host discovery, no social engineering.
- Timing: preferred window May 10–14; Redwood will provide a read-only snapshot and a breakglass contact.
- Hard constraints: no automated brute-force tests against auth endpoints; rate limits will be coordinated to avoid service disruption.
- Deliverables: report in PDF, CVSS mapping, remediation playbook (if critical findings).

I'm OK with the May 10 week but need FastPay to confirm exact target endpoints (list of hostnames/paths) and indicate whether they require encrypted log ingestion during testing.

Attachments: pen-test-scope.txt (text, 6KB)

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
